cfy_sync_core_to_legacy:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cfy_sync_core_to_legacy()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.clients(code,name_ar,name_en,brand_type,phone,whatsapp,tier,active,status,sub_start,sub_end,updated_at)
  values(
    new.code,
    new.brand_name_ar,
    new.brand_name_en,
    new.business_type,
    new.whatsapp,
    new.whatsapp,
    case when new.tier='premium' then 'prem' else 'std' end,
    new.active,
    case when new.active then 'active' else 'inactive' end,
    new.sub_start,
    new.sub_end,
    now()
  )
  on conflict(code) do update set
    name_ar=excluded.name_ar,
    name_en=excluded.name_en,
    brand_type=excluded.brand_type,
    phone=excluded.phone,
    whatsapp=excluded.whatsapp,
    tier=excluded.tier,
    active=excluded.active,
    status=excluded.status,
    sub_start=excluded.sub_start,
    sub_end=excluded.sub_end,
    updated_at=now();
  return new;
end $function$
cfy_sync_social_to_legacy:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cfy_sync_social_to_legacy()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_code text;
begin
  select code into v_code from public.cfy_clients where id=new.client_id;
  if v_code is not null then
    update public.clients set
      tag=new.tagline,
      facebook=new.facebook,
      instagram=new.instagram,
      tiktok=new.tiktok,
      website=new.website,
      map_link=new.map_link,
      instapay=new.instapay,
      vodafone_cash=new.vodafone_cash,
      gallery=new.gallery,
      design=new.design,
      card=new.card,
      updated_at=now()
    where code=v_code;
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$
cfy_delete_legacy_client:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cfy_delete_legacy_client()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  delete from public.clients where code=old.code;
  return old;
end $function$
